performance.verdict: No paid channels live 52 days in; SOW milestones are the real crisis.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages were all due 2026-07-31 — now 21 days overdue with no confirmed completion event.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting were due 2026-08-01 — 20 days overdue; $0 spend across all paid channels confirms neither is live.
GHL shows 369 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — pipeline intake is either not built or not routing, blocking signed-case measurement.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on 2026-08-18/19/20 (3-day signal) vs avg ~3/day prior — organic floor is gone and the only lead source is now dark.
IG reach dropped 36.36% week-over-week; last 3 days averaged 704 vs prior 3-day avg of 961 — social organic also trending down alongside GBP.

suggestions.text: Escalate SOW blocker to Nacer immediately: unblock LSA verification, site launch, and stack test — all 21+ days overdue.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are overdue by 20–21 days with $0 paid spend confirmed across all channels. Nacer must confirm status of LSA verification submission, site/landing page live date, and pre-launch stack test by 2026-08-24. Success is defined as each milestone marked complete with a verified date. If LSA verification has not been submitted, it must go in today — it carries a 3–4 week approval window that further delays go-live.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline build: 369 contacts, 0 opportunities, 0 appointments signals intake routing is broken or never built.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 369 contacts but zero opportunities created and zero appointments booked over the 28-day window. This means leads are entering the CRM but not being routed or staged — the intake funnel is not functional. The CRM team should audit pipeline stages, assignment rules, and form-to-opportunity triggers by 2026-08-25. Success is at least one test lead flowing end-to-end from form submission to an open opportunity in Clio Manage.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 0 actions on 3 consecutive days (Aug 18–20); if zero persists through Aug 24, investigate listing suspension or ranking drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero on 2026-08-18, 2026-08-19, and 2026-08-20 — the only active lead-generating channel is now dark for 3 consecutive days. This may reflect a listing issue, suspension, or a drop in local pack ranking. Re-check GBP actions on 2026-08-24; if still at zero, escalate to an immediate listing audit before paid launch, since GBP feeds direct calls and web clicks that are the only pipeline pressure currently in place.
